data.name: ClankOut
data.detailed_description:
ClankOut

Enter the FragDome, a coliseum suspended over the void where warrior robots fight for glory and the entertainment of the masses. In this frantic multiplayer FPS, speed, mobility, and skill make the difference between victory and defeat.

Run on walls, slide at full speed, chain impossible jumps together, and master a fluid movement system designed to reward technique and creativity. Find weapons scattered around the arena, use your utilities, and outplay your rivals in intense duels full of action and chaos.

Main Features

  • Fast-paced and dynamic combat.

  • Advanced mobility system with parkour, slides, double jumps, and wall running.

  • Unique weapons with different playstyles.

  • Post-apocalyptic dieselpunk setting featuring combat robots.

  • Competitive matches focused on skill and self-improvement.

  • Play with friends or challenge other players in intense confrontations.

data.short_description: ClankOut is a fast-paced arena shooter FPS set in a post-apocalyptic world. Use parkour to outwit your rivals in coliseums suspended over the void. Acquire absurd weapons, master movement, and become the last survivor to please the coliseum crowd.
